description: Operator messages from a chat channel, in English and Spanish, turned into a draft the operator confirms. State: {text}, the message's text, at most 500 characters; the channel and the sender stay in the workflow, because the channel acted as a prior. Criteria are in English, and asset aliases list the local names in parentheses. 'other' and 'pump' mean no answer: the workflow asks with buttons. Greetings and thanks are filtered by rules first; 'other' catches the ones that get past them. Thresholds and the intent coverage gate are fitted to the generic evaluation file; a site renames the assets, adds its own examples and refits (p4n4 ai system1 eval --fit-thresholds).

criteria.report_fault: reports a fault, damage, noise, leak or abnormal behaviour
criteria.status_request: asks for the current status or a reading
criteria.maintenance_request: asks for maintenance, a spare part or a visit
criteria.other: a greeting, thanks or chat, nothing to do

asset.instructions: Which asset is the message about?

criteria.pump: a pump, without saying which one (la bomba, una bomba)
